title: Return, iv
logline: Thursday. The program on the corkboard: the strip draws it as a folded card, unreadable, pinned beside the 1999 bus schedule. Wood pins it and does not look at it and the strip does not look at it either.

margin.note: A second, smaller date under the gull.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD with a folded card — cream, a program of some kind, the printing blurred by the strip. BARNABY.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a man holding a folded cream card whose printing is deliberately blurred, an old dog beside him
image.notes: The program from the sabbatical (see dw_2010-10-04 notes). Unreadable. The afterword says what it is.

panels.composition: The pin going in. The card beside the 1999 schedule. Two folded things, both facing the wall.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, close-up of a folded card being pinned to a corkboard beside an older folded schedule, both blank sides out

panels.composition: Wood stepping back. Not looking. Looking at the sill instead. The jar.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a man standing back from a corkboard and looking instead at a jar on a windowsill, no words

panels.composition: The garage. The corkboard with two folded things. The man at the table. The dog. Under the signature: the second, smaller date.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with cleaner flats, a garage studio with a crowded corkboard, a man at a drafting table and an old dog, no words
image.notes: Margin: the second smaller date under the mark, as on Oct 4.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The program pinned, unread. The second date.
